title: RunnerQ conductor protocol, version 1
description: Between a worker's agent and the RunnerQ Cloud gateway, over a WebSocket. See README.md. An optional field is omitted when it doesn't apply, never null. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision; durations are integer milliseconds named *_ms; ids are opaque strings.

Kind.description: What an envelope is: a request, its response, or an event.

Envelope.description: One frame on the wire: one JSON object per WebSocket text frame.

v.description: The protocol version the sender speaks; 1.

id.description: Set on requests and echoed by their response.

type.description: The message type, e.g. activities.list; a response echoes its request's.

data.description: The message's data (see x-messages); absent with error.

error.description: Replaces data in a failed response.

Meta.description: Out-of-band fields; receivers ignore keys they don't know.

deadline.description: When the sender stops waiting for the response.

ErrorCode.description: A failure class. Agents reject anything they don't understand with unsupported.

Error.description: A failed response, or a failed item in a command result.

details.description: invalid_argument and unsupported name the input as field; failed_precondition gives the activity's status.

ExecutorInfo.description: The worker process behind a session.

id.description: Stable for the process; a newer session with the same id supersedes an older one.

Capability.description: One message type an agent serves, and the sub-features it supports; only the lists relevant to the message are set.

metrics.description: count, and duration.<field> for each duration field.

TargetKind.description: How a command can select its activities.

Limits.description: One side's limits; the effective limit is the smaller of the two.

Hello.description: The agent's handshake, its first frame.

protocol_versions.description: Versions the agent speaks; the gateway picks the highest both do.

AppRef.description: The app a session belongs to.

DataMode.description: What an agent may send: full, or metadata_only (no payloads, results, error messages or event details).

SessionConfig.description: The gateway's settings for a session; config.update carries the fields that change.

Goodbye.description: Sent by an agent before a graceful shutdown.

FilterOp.description: A filter predicate's operator; contains needs the text capability.

Filter.description: A boolean expression over a resource's fields: exactly one of the combinators (and, or, not) or a predicate (field, op, value).

field.description: A dotted path into the resource; metadata.<key> addresses a metadata tag.

value.description: The operand: a list for in and nin, absent for exists.

Sort.description: Orders a query by one advertised field; agents add the id as a tiebreaker.

include.description: Heavy fields to return: payload, result, last_error.

CountResult.description: A count; over large sets an agent may estimate, and say so.

TreeRequest.description: Fetches the tree an activity belongs to; id may be any activity in it.

Bucket.description: Splits an aggregate into time buckets.

field.description: An advertised time field, e.g. completed_at.

DurationField.description: queue: created or scheduled to first start; run: last attempt's start to completion; total: created to completion.

durations.description: Duration field (run) to percentile (p95) to milliseconds.

ActivityStatus.description: A canonical status. A retry is scheduled with attempt above 1; there is no retrying status.

Result.description: An activity's or step's outcome: data when ok, error when not.

WaitKind.description: What a waiting activity is parked on.

Wait.description: Why a waiting activity is parked.

Activity.description: An activity. Fields that don't apply are omitted, not null.

attempt.description: The current or last attempt, from 1.

executor_id.description: The executor running it, while running.

payload.description: When included; never in metadata-only mode.

result.description: When included; never in metadata-only mode.

steps.description: When included on activities.get; an included empty list is [].

events.description: When included on activities.get; an included empty list is [].

extensions.description: SDK-specific data keyed by SDK language; the Cloud may show it but never depends on it.

Step.description: A durable checkpoint inside an activity.

status.description: completed or failed, from its result.

child_id.description: When the step spawned a child.

Event.description: An entry in an activity's history.

id.description: Unique; consumers drop repeats by it.

cursor.description: Ordered, shared across the app's executors.

type.description: A group and name: activity.created, attempt.started, ... Unknown types are shown generically.

RunningActivity.description: An activity in flight on an executor.

ExecutorCounters.description: Activity outcomes since the executor started.

ExecutorState.description: An executor's live, in-memory state: executor.describe's answer, and (without running) executor.report's data.

running.description: On executor.describe and hosted reports, [] when nothing runs; omitted from executor.report.

claim_lag_ms.description: How long the latest activity waited to start after it was due.

ExecutorReport.description: A hosted worker's heartbeat to the data plane (PUT /v1/executors/{id}, with the store key; see the storage protocol): its hello's sdk and executor, and its state with running.

Target.description: What a command acts on: ids, a filter bounded by max, or an idempotency key and type (signals).

queue.description: Set by the Cloud: the queue the routed executor serves. A mismatch is failed_precondition.

CancelCascade.description: children (the default) also cancels non-terminal descendants.

DeleteCascade.description: Delete removes a finished root with its whole tree, the only cascade and the default.

CancelRequest.description: activities.cancel: cancel non-terminal activities. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

RetryRequest.description: activities.retry: run failed, dead-lettered or cancelled activities again, keeping their checkpoints. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

RunNowRequest.description: activities.run_now: make scheduled or waiting activities runnable now. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

RescheduleRequest.description: activities.reschedule: move a scheduled activity's time. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

SetPriorityRequest.description: activities.set_priority: change non-terminal activities' priority. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

DeleteRequest.description: activities.delete: delete finished roots with their trees and history. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

SignalRequest.description: activities.signal: deliver a signal, waking the activity if it waits. Each command accepts only its own fields.

command_id.description: Makes the command idempotent: the same id replays the stored outcome; with different input it is a conflict. The Cloud always sends one; without it nothing is recorded or replayed.

dry_run.description: Say what would happen, changing nothing.

CommandOutcome.description: What happened to one target; would_apply on dry runs.

CommandResult.description: A command's outcome. Per-item failures don't fail the request; a request-level error means nothing was applied.

cascaded.description: Descendants a cascading cancel also cancelled.

more.description: A bounded filter target left more to act on.

EventsSubscribe.description: Starts an event stream; without after_cursor it starts at the end of the log.

Subscription.description: A subscription and where it starts.

StreamEvents.description: A batch of a subscription's events; cursor is where to resume.

StreamGap.description: Events after since_cursor may have been lost; re-query them with events.list.

x-messages.description: The first frame, within 10 seconds of connecting.
The fields that change; the agent applies them at once.
